_comment: Databricks Jobs API definition for the LSQ Mavis ingestion pipeline.
Import via: databricks jobs create --json @jobs/lsq_mavis_ingestion_job.json
Or via the Databricks UI: Workflows → Create Job → Import JSON.
BEFORE IMPORTING — update the following placeholders:
REPLACE_WITH_REPO_PATH  : e.g. /Repos/data-eng/databricks-ingestion-framework
REPLACE_WITH_NODE_TYPE  : e.g. Standard_DS3_v2 (Azure) or i3.xlarge (AWS)
Two-task structure (mirrors ADF PL_LSQ_Mavis_Main):
Task 0 — get_table_details : Initialises config status + fetches active rows,
publishes via taskValues (replaces LK_Initialize_Ingestion_Status +
LK_Get_Mavis_config_details + SV_Trigger_Time).
Task 1 — run_ingestion     : Reads taskValues, fans out to MavisOrchestrator
per table (replaces ForEach → PL_LSQ_Mavis_Raw_To_Silver).
Job-level parameters (set once, available to both tasks):
batch_start_date    : '1' for today (default), or 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' in IST
admin_catalog_name  : Unity Catalog name holding the config schema
raw_sa_name         : ADLS Gen2 storage account name for raw ZIP/CSV landing
audit_table         : FQN of the shared audit log Delta table
dependency_table    : FQN of dependency_master_config Delta table
silver_notebook_path: Workspace path to the Mavis Silver notebook
silver_notebook_timeout: Max seconds to wait per Silver notebook run
environment         : dev | uat | prod
pipeline_name       : Pipeline name written to audit rows
name: lsq_mavis_source_to_silver_ingestion

parameters.name: batch_start_date
parameters.description: Batch start date: '1' = today's UTC run; else 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' IST for a re-run.

parameters.name: admin_catalog_name
parameters.description: Unity Catalog name that holds the config schema (e.g. pfl_admin_catalog).

parameters.name: s3_bucket_name
parameters.description: S3 bucket name for raw ZIP/CSV landing (e.g. pflrawsa).

parameters.name: audit_table
parameters.description: FQN of the shared audit log Delta table (e.g. pfl_admin_catalog.config.tb_audit_log).

parameters.name: dependency_table
parameters.description: FQN of the dependency master config Delta table.

parameters.name: silver_notebook_path
parameters.description: Workspace path to the Mavis Silver transformation notebook (blank = skip Silver).

parameters.name: silver_notebook_timeout
parameters.description: Max seconds to wait for each Silver notebook run.

parameters.name: pipeline_name
parameters.description: Pipeline name written to audit log rows.

parameters.name: job_run_id
parameters.description: Databricks job run ID — auto-populated from job context.

_comment: Task 0 — get_table_details
Initialises config status (mirrors LK_Initialize_Ingestion_Status) and
fetches active rows (mirrors LK_Get_Mavis_config_details), then publishes
results via taskValues for Task 1 to consume.
Task 1 — run_ingestion
Reads taskValues from get_table_details, then fans out to MavisOrchestrator
per table (mirrors ForEach → PL_LSQ_Mavis_Raw_To_Silver).
Per-table flow: API export trigger → poll → ZIP download → unzip → Silver notebook.
